notes: MSI agent training deck, September 2025, describing two programs MSI sells: MSI Flood (Sutton Specialty) and Hiscox FloodPlus. The states listed for Hiscox FloodPlus are where MSI offers it, which may be narrower than Hiscox's own availability. MSI Flood's '$1.25M combined building/content limit' is labeled total_insured_value. Hiscox's ICC ('$30K or 5% of Building, whichever is greater') has no fixed amount and isn't labeled. 'Buildings not walled and roofed', farms, geocoding and replacement-cost caps are 'other'. The deck says its criteria are not exhaustive.

property_exclusions.detail: buildings not walled and roofed; farms
more than 50% of the contents on a subgrade floor
commercial exposure, asbestos or adobe construction, docks or houseboats, no permanent foundation
